```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let header be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)
  let separator be render_row(cells: widths.map("-----"), widths: widths)
  let body be
    for each row in table.rows
    collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)
  return [header, separator].append_all(body).join("\n")
end
```

```renyi
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """

    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)

  let header be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)

  let separator_cells be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let separator be render_row(cells: separator_cells, widths: widths)

  let body be
    for each row in table.rows
    collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)

  let lines be [header, separator].append_all(body)
  return lines.join("\n")
end
```

```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)

  let header be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)
  let separator be render_row(
    cells:
      for each width in widths
      collect "-".repeat(width),
    widths: widths
  )

  let mutable lines: List of Text be [header, separator]
  for each row in table.rows
    set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end

  return lines.join("\n")
end
```

```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let header be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)
  let separator be render_row(cells: for each width in widths collect "-".repeat(width), widths: widths)
  let body be for each row in table.rows collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)

  if body.is_empty() then
    return "{header}\n{separator}"
  otherwise
    return "{header}\n{separator}\n{body.join("\n")}"
  end
end
```
